title: Style guides live in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; Copilot instruction files must point at them
answers: where are the Python or GitHub Actions style guides now
I moved a style rule file, what else must I update
Copilot review instructions link to a missing rules file
relative links broken inside the python or actions style guide
body:
Convention: the Python and GitHub Actions style guides are shared skills at `.claude/skills/python-style/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/github-actions-style/SKILL.md`, not path-scoped `.claude/rules/*.md` files.
Each SKILL.md needs frontmatter with `name` and `description`; the description says when to use the skill.
The Copilot entry points `.github/instructions/python.instructions.md` and `.github/instructions/github-actions.instructions.md` must link to these SKILL.md paths and keep their `applyTo` scopes.
Moving a guide one directory deeper adds a `../` to each relative link inside it (e.g. `../../../.github/policy.rego`, `../../../dev/clint/`).
`.agents/skills` is a symlink to `../.claude/skills`, so skills are visible to both agent tools; do not duplicate them.
Constraints: this is a placement convention only; skills need selection or invocation, so the rule text is not guaranteed to load automatically.
applies: Editing or adding style guides under .claude/skills/ or the .github/instructions/ pointers in this repository.
says: Copilot code review suggestions reference broken links for Python coding style conventions.
Where can I find the shared style guidelines for GitHub Actions workflows?
Fix broken relative documentation links after reorganizing repository coding style guides.
Copilot instructions cannot find the relocated style guide documents during reviews.
Ensure assistant coding rules and style documents are shared without duplicating files.
